entries.name: GPTFootprint
entries.type: ACM CHI Extended Abstracts conference contribution
entries.review_status: Formal EA publication confirmed; do not equate with CHI Papers full-review track. Track-specific review depth not independently established.
entries.authority_assessment: Established HCI publication context; exploratory evidential weight, especially given nine participants and one week.
entries.claim_fit: Eco Score, nature images and estimated usage feedback in actual ChatGPT; not an isolated word/icon causal test.
entries.decision: Retain as exploratory related work with type and limits stated.
entries.content_access: Author manuscript read; publisher DOI landing page returned 403, so Crossref and Princeton official record used to corroborate publication.

entries.name: EcoChat Probe
entries.review_status: King's official repository explicitly marks peer-review; publisher-deposited Crossref metadata confirms proceedings article, 5194–5218, published 2026-06-25.
entries.authority_assessment: Suitable peer-reviewed core adjacent research on sustainable AI interaction; results not a label-only estimate.
entries.claim_fit: Official abstract supports ChatGPT extension, 52 participants over four weeks, reported awareness/reflection and no significant usage-pattern change.
entries.decision: Retain as core adjacent feedback research; keep claims within available official abstract.
entries.content_access: Official metadata and abstract confirmed. Publisher and final PDF fetches returned 403. Detailed original stimulus and analysis comparison remains incomplete.

entries.name: Good for the Planet, Bad for Me?
entries.review_status: Official CHI Papers review process and published proceedings registration confirmed; official SIGCHI awards search lists Honorable Mention.
entries.authority_assessment: Strongest directly adjacent HCI core reference in this set; award does not independently validate every causal interpretation.
entries.claim_fit: 365 participants, energy disclosure added to performance ratings, both choices GPT-4o mini. Different intervention from Light/Eco-only naming; self-selected model groups should not be treated as randomized causal quality comparisons.
entries.content_access: Author full text and institutional record read. Official awards search excerpt matches title/authors; award page itself is JavaScript-only in text fetch.

entries.name: From Perception to Action
entries.type: arXiv preprint; related PROFES 2026 Short Papers and Posters accepted listing
entries.review_status: Official accepted track confirmed; final Springer/publisher version and publication DOI not verified. Do not mark formally published. Exact short-vs-poster category not resolved.
entries.authority_assessment: Useful supplementary study, weaker publication status for this audit than verified published conference papers.
entries.claim_fit: Author manuscript combines modes, per-response/pre-send feedback, dashboard and energy analogies; no isolated Eco-name causal estimate.
entries.decision: Move to supplementary related work. Retain preprint title and state acceptance separately.
bibliographic_cautions: Author PDF and official conference list use Jack Gläser; arXiv metadata uses Glässer.
Conference title adds 'Use?' compared with the arXiv title.
LIPIcs CVIT2016/10.4230/LIPIcs.CVIT.2016.23 in the manuscript is sample template residue, not a verified publication DOI.
entries.content_access: Audit worker downloaded and inspected author PDF; root independently opened official conference accepted-program evidence. No final-publication equivalence asserted.

entries.name: When LLMs Slow Down
entries.type: ICT4S 2026 Research Papers proceedings article, IEEE publisher, 322–334
entries.review_status: Official track specifies review by three experts, double-blind. Crossref record matches title, six authors, publication 2026-06 and IEEE publisher.
entries.authority_assessment: Relevant peer-reviewed specialist-conference evidence; IEEE publication should not be described as IEEE conference sponsorship.
entries.claim_fit: Live response latency and model-estimated carbon information, official abstract N89; not a label-only comparison or measured proof of ecological protection.
entries.decision: Replace arXiv-only bibliography entry with formal proceedings DOI; retain related-work role.
entries.content_access: Official conference and root Crossref metadata checked; audit worker inspected author PDF. Final publisher PDF not compared line-by-line against preprint.

entries.name: Key Questions on Energy and AI
entries.review_status: Expert review acknowledgments in report, distinct from journal/conference article peer-review publication. No DOI verified.
entries.authority_assessment: Authoritative institutional energy-analysis background, not an empirical HCI paper.
entries.claim_fit: Model/task/hardware/serving conditions and uncertain aggregate demand are background context; not direct experimental proof about named Eco settings.
entries.decision: Retain only in explicitly labeled institutional background section.
entries.content_access: Root official publication page read; environment auditor inspected PDF including review acknowledgments and printed pages28–30.

entries.name: Transformative AI and Demand Bottlenecks
entries.review_status: Working-paper version, published2026-10-12; manuscript date2026-10-10. Journal peer-review publication not verified.
entries.authority_assessment: Recognized institution's technical working paper, with author-view disclaimer; not equivalent to established peer-reviewed empirical evidence.
entries.claim_fit: Calibrated endogenous-growth model links consumer-product rents to innovation; does not test Eco labels, ChatGPT usage cuts or real release delays.
entries.decision: Remove from core naming-study bibliography and separate as long-term theoretical background; not deleted as nonexistent.
entries.content_access: Official publication record and PDF inspected; exact Eco-use causal evidence not established.
